#### Pharmacodynamic:

+--------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Mechanisms   | - Central DA~2~ antagonist (Binds G~i~ GPCR → ↓cAMP)                              |
|              | - ↓Afferents from chemoreceptor trigger zone to vomiting centre                   |
|              | - α-adrenoceptor antagonist                                                       |
+--------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Use (dose)   | - PONV prevention or rescue (0.5-0.625mg in adults)                               |
|              | - Anti-psychosis, chemical restraint )1.25-2.5mg slowly IV, q10 mins; max 10mg)   |
|              | - Neuroleptanaesthesia                                                            |

| Side effects | - Sedation                                                                        |
|              | - Mild hypotension                                                                |
|              | - EPSE:                                                                           |
|              |   - Parkinsonism (tremor)                                                         |
|              |   - Akathisia (restlessness)                                                      |
|              |   - Tardive dyskinesia (rhythmic voluntary movements of the tongue, face and jaw) |
